description: At the core of spellcraft are spectrums only the very gifted can sense.
trivia: Octarine Core's name is an homage to the comic fantasy book series Discworld, paying tribute to the writer Terry Pratchett who died about a month prior to the item's release.
The components of Octarine Core before version 7.27 are the same as the components of the Pre-6.60 Aghanim's Scepter.
tips: If you have a hero with short cooldowns on your abilities, consider this item; casting your spells more often in a single fight is a major boon.
name: Octarine Core
